name: Colossus Might
desc: Titanic strength surges through your limbs, enough to swing the Colossus Hammer.
apply_message: The hammer's weight seems to fall away as your muscles swell.
remove_message: The surge of titanic strength fades.

description: Channel crystallized mana through the hammer to gain +20 Strength for a time.

//: min_strength 35 (same field as Dragonslayer's 20). Weight and to_hit add to the penalty at low Str; the wield spell adds +20 Str.
description: An absurdly massive two-handed maul of rune-etched steel, roughly twice the weight of a sledgehammer. Swinging it well takes around 35 Strength, but every landed blow is devastating. Loaded with crystallized mana, its use action grants +20 Strength for a time (must be wielded).
